convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicators (ColorMaRsi-Trigger) which are external custom indicators not available as built-in MT5 indicators. Requires manual recreation of the custom indicator logic in Python or sourcing the indicator source code.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one (Duplex behavior - reverse on signal change)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lot value = fixed lot size; Positive Lot value = fraction of deposit margin calculation (MarginCheck-based sizing)

custom_logic_notes: Duplex EA means it is always-in-market: it closes the opposite position and opens a new one on signal reversal rather than going flat. The ColorMaRsi-Trigger is a composite indicator combining Moving Average and RSI with color-coded trigger signals. When the buy buffer outputs a non-empty/non-zero value, it triggers a long entry; when the sell buffer outputs a non-empty/non-zero value, it triggers a short entry. The 'Duplex' suffix indicates the EA operates in reverse-on-signal mode, always holding a position.
external_dependencies: ColorMaRsi-Trigger.ex5 (custom indicator required for iCustom calls)
python_conversion_notes: The ColorMaRsi-Trigger custom indicator logic must be reverse-engineered or sourced separately. It likely combines a Moving Average with RSI filtering to produce binary buy/sell trigger signals. The MA method, period, and RSI period are encapsulated within the custom indicator and must be extracted from its .mq5 source. The Duplex (always-in) behavior means every signal reversal both closes the existing position and opens a new opposite one - implement as a single close+open operation pair. The conditional lot sizing (negative=fixed lots, positive=margin fraction) must be replicated. New bar guard is essential for preventing multiple entries per bar.
